preconditions.description: The number of towns in Dudeland is between 3 and 105.
The number of monasteries is between 2 and n-1.
The towns are indexed from 1 to n.
The length of each road is between 1 and 1000.
There are no self-loops in the road network.

postconditions.description: The output is a tuple containing the maximum number of pilgrims that can be made unhappy and the number of ways to achieve this.
